context: M14 o4. Varelas & Co. vaults, the cold room. Breath shows. Racks of stored coats in garment bags.

lines.speaker: char.yiannis_doukas
lines.text: Mr. Varelas is at the bank. Again. I pay you. Like every month.

lines.speaker: char.yiannis_doukas
lines.text: Four hundred coats from uptown sleep here till October. Mink, fox, persian.

lines.speaker: char.teddy_arce
lines.text: Lot of money behind one door.

lines.speaker: char.yiannis_doukas
lines.text: And one compressor. When the power goes, the coats go. Nobody thinks of that.

lines.speaker: char.yiannis_doukas
lines.text: A skin tells you where it was cut. So does a man. You were police, yes?
